title: Place-Based Policy from Space: Evidence from Italy's Inner Areas
abstract: arXiv:2611.31100v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper evaluates a place-based policy, Italy's National Strategy for Inner Areas (SNAI), using satellite nighttime lights. Targeting structurally fragile and peripheral municipalities, SNAI invests in essential services and economic activities. Staggered difference-in-differences compares 941 funded municipalities with 3,112 eligible controls over 2011--2022. Funding is associated with an expansion of lit area and no detectable change in radiance per lit cell, suggesting that activity extends its footprint rather than intensifying in existing centres. The expansion holds across comparison groups and, descriptively, concentrates at intermediate funding per resident. Annual satellite data can complement slower and coarser statistics.

translated_title: 从太空看地方政策：来自意大利内陆地区的证据
translated_abstract: 本文利用卫星夜间灯光数据评估了一项地方性政策——意大利国家内陆地区战略（SNAI）。该战略针对结构脆弱且地处边远的市镇，投资于基本服务和经济活动。研究采用交错双重差分法，在2011年至2022年间将941个获得资助的市镇与3,112个符合条件的对照市镇进行比较。结果表明，资金投入与灯光覆盖面积的扩大相关，而每个灯光像元的辐射亮度未见可检测的变化，这表明经济活动是拓展其空间足迹，而非在现有中心加剧集聚。这一扩张效应在不同对比组中均成立，且从描述性来看，其集中在人均中等资助水平上。年度卫星数据可以补充更新较慢、分辨率较粗的传统统计数据。
tldr: 本文利用卫星夜间灯光数据评估意大利国家内陆地区战略（SNAI），发现资助使灯光覆盖面积扩大但单位亮度未变，表明政策促使经济活动向更广区域延伸而非在既有中心集聚，展示了卫星数据在评估地方性政策上的价值。
en_tdlr: Using satellite nighttime lights, this paper finds that Italy's Inner Areas Strategy (SNAI) expanded the spatial footprint of economic activity—lit area grew without increased radiance—showing that annual satellite data can effectively evaluate place-based policies.
